pages.title: Colony
pages.text: **Swarm.** There are no bees to find in the void, so you make somewhere a bee wants to be: a ring of oak logs around a small flower, placed on the pad and woken with another flower (right-click it). Wait. Wings.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Every nest is the same trick with a different ring — gravel, coarse dirt, stone, quartz, end stone. Then hives, a centrifuge, an incubator, and deep essence crops. Keep something alive that keeps something else alive.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text:
**Goal:** finish Swarm and seat the Swarm token.\
You need a nest the pad can actually grow — oak logs around a flower, woken with a right-click from another flower — then hives.\
**Check:** Finish Swarm. Claim the token and seat it. The Swarm notch lights.

pages.title: Continue
pages.text: Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
